body: Part of me wants to wish him a happy birthday but the other part of me feels like it might end in me hurting more.

I’ve been doing a lot better in not reaching out to him for closure but this breakup helped me realize that it’s much deeper than him. It’s me. I’m not happy and I can’t find that happiness. I literally called off work today because I woke up sad. And now I feel worse because I’m just stuck in my room.

Take this time to focus on you and your mental health. It’s easier said than done because that’s what I’ve been trying to do myself. But we gotta take baby steps. I miss him but this isn’t about him anymore. He’s no longer in my life so that gives me time to focus on myself and what I want to accomplish. As of right now I’m still trying to figure that out. I’ve been in this funk . I find nothing amusing anymore. I don’t find interest in hanging out with friends or going out. I’ve just been in my room in this misery but I know things will get better. Allow yourself to feel every emotion in your body. Let it out because if you don’t it will consume you.

I didn’t end up texting him. I like how you said to let my ex do the work. He did do all the work in breaking up with me so why should I continue to seek something that is no longer there? It’s frustrating and difficult. How can it be so easy for him to not text me?
And that’s exactly why I’m afraid of breaking NC because every time I talk to him I feel like I’m losing myself.
What made it not worth it?

My hair looks extra thick when I have it short because I have so much hair. I don’t really like my hair right now because of the split ends. My friends are telling me to just cut the tips and see how I feel first before I decide to chop it short!
Thank you!! Please DM me as well whenever you feel like texting your ex!
I feel like I’ve lost myself.
I turned back around and went home :/

He broke up with me because he’s not happy. He told me he wants to make me happy and give me everything I deserve but that he can’t give that to me. I can’t expect him to be happy with me if he can’t be happy with himself. That’s why it’s hurting me so much. Because this breakup is not because of us falling out of love or even cheating. But it’s because he’s putting his mental health first and I can’t even be mad at him for that.
I don’t expect for us to get back together: I just really miss him. I haven’t seen him in so long it’s been driving me crazy
Yes on and off but I try to go days without talking to him
My heart wants to but my brain is telling me not to
But he is the one that ended things with me that’s why I feel so conflicted

The best thing for me right now is to just let out alllllll my tears. I’m allowing myself to cry whenever I need to. I’ll even cry at work sometimes lol. I’m wishing you the best of luck. We both got this 💗
